description: Starts the import of a spreadsheet uploaded with upload_spreadsheet, as Start in the import drawer does: Sergio checks its columns; a confident mapping imports, an uncertain one answers status needs_review and waits for review_import_mapping. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: start_spreadsheet_import
title: Start an uploaded spreadsheet's import
